withdraw.title: Wepụ kredit a na-ejighị
withdraw.feeBack: Nke a gụnyere ụgwọ Mingla {{fee}}. Ọ na-alaghachi n'ụzọ ị kwụrụ, na {{currency}}, malite na ịkwụ ụgwọ kacha ochie.
withdraw.done: Ewepụla ya. Ọ na-alaghachi n'ụzọ ị kwụrụ.
withdraw.nothing: Enweghị kredit dị njikere iwepụ. Kredit edobere na-alaghachi mgbe mgbasa ozi gwụrụ.
withdraw.failed: Anyị enweghị ike iwepụ ugbu a. Ewereghị ihe ọ bụla; nwaa ọzọ n'ime otu nkeji.
